You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #4 for @mobile-tasks):

You are the mobile task screens builder for the Kezza Agent Rewards app (Phase 4).

Workspace root: `/Users/ravi/.codex/.chatgpt-projects/g-p-6ae81da483248191a7e1c68af4392bce/kezza-agent-app 2`

## Context — read these first
- `.gsd/SPEC.md` (FR-2, FR-3, FR-6)
- `src/app/add-patient.tsx`
- `src/app/referral/[id].tsx`
- `src/app/add-payment.tsx`
- `src/app/payment-claim/[id].tsx`
- `src/features/referrals/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/referrals/types.ts`
- `src/features/payments/hooks.ts`
- `src/features/payments/types.ts`
- `src/constants/theme.ts`
- `src/components/Button.tsx`
- `src/components/FormField.tsx`
- `src/components/Screen.tsx`
- `src/components/StatusBadge.tsx`
- `src/lib/api.ts`
- `src/lib/format.ts`
- `src/lib/errors.ts`
- `docs/backend-integration.md`

## Your tasks (P4-T1 through P4-T5)

**P4-T1: add-patient.tsx — Complete (currently 100 lines)**
Full implementation must include:
- Patient full name field (required)
- Patient phone field (Indian mobile, validated, unique enforced by API)
- Service picker (fetch from /agent/services, show picker/dropdown)
- Agent note field (optional, 300 char max)
- Consent section: fetch active legal document from /agent/legal-documents, display the consent text in a scrollable box, require checkbox "I confirm the patient has given verbal consent" before submit is enabled
- Idempotency key: generate UUID on screen mount, stable across retry
- Submit: POST /agent/referrals; show loading; on success: navigate to referral/[id] for the new referral; on error: show InlineNotice with specific message (duplicate phone = patient already referred)
- Duplicate-submit protection (disable button after first submit until response)

**P4-T2: referral/[id].tsx — Complete (currently 71 lines)**
Full implementation:
- Load referral detail from /agent/referrals/{id}
- Display: patient name (masked phone in list, full name in detail), service, branch, date, status badge, agent note
- Status history: list of referral_events with actor, status, note, date
- Linked payment claims: list with status, claimed amount, link to claim detail
- Action: if status allows update (new, contacted, in_progress), show status update button → modal/picker with allowed next statuses
- Loading, error, not-found states
- Modal presented (this is a modal route per _layout.tsx)

**P4-T3: add-payment.tsx — Complete (currently 93 lines)**
Full implementation:
- Referral picker: search by patient name or referral ref; show only referrals eligible for payment (not already converted to closed)
- Invoice number field (required, format hint)
- Invoice amount in rupees (convert to paise on submit, validate > 0)
- Collected amount in rupees (validate > 0 and ≤ invoice amount)
- Payment date picker (default today)
- Payment method picker: cash, upi, card, cheque, other
- Transaction reference field (optional, required for UPI/card/cheque)
- Notes field (optional, 500 char max)
- Idempotency key: UUID on mount
- Submit: POST /agent/payments/claims
- After submit: navigate to payment-claim/[id] for the new claim

**P4-T4: payment-claim/[id].tsx — Complete (currently 93 lines)**
Full implementation:
- Load claim detail from /agent/payments/claims/{id}
- Display: referral, invoice ref, claimed amount, payment date, method, status badge
- Reviewer feedback section: show review_reason if status is needs_information or rejected
- Decision history: list of payment_decisions with reviewer, decision, amount, reason, date
- Evidence section: list uploaded evidence files, button to upload new evidence (expo-document-picker, JPEG/PNG/PDF, max 8MB)
- Respond action: if status is needs_information → show text field for response note → POST /agent/payments/claims/{id}/respond → resubmits claim
- Loading, error, not-found states

**P4-T5: Mutation hooks**
Add to `features/referrals/hooks.ts`:
- `useCreateReferral()` mutation
- `useUpdateReferralStatus(id)` mutation

Add to `features/payments/hooks.ts`:
- `useCreatePaymentClaim()` mutation
- `useUploadEvidence(claimId)` mutation (multipart/form-data)
- `useRespondToClaim(claimId)` mutation

Ensure types in `features/payments/types.ts` and `features/referrals/types.ts` cover all request + response shapes used.

## Standards
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- All states: loading, error, empty, populated
- Duplicate-submit protection on all forms
- Money fields: display as rupees (2 decimal), store as paise (integer × 100)
- Use existing theme and components
- DO NOT touch tab screens, auth screens, or backend files

## Commits
One commit per task: `git add -A` then `git commit -m "feat(mobile): P4-Tx description"`
Confirm: `git log -1 --oneline`

## When done
Post to @coordinator:
- Summary of each screen built
- Any TypeScript errors found
- `git log --oneline -5`
